columns.name: MASK_FIELD_ID
columns.description: Primary key for this table. System generated.

columns.name: GV_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Stores the context code for which all the views will be stored. For example : Context can be ORA_SUBMISSION and all the fields related to Job Application would be specified with this context code.

columns.name: FIELD_CODE
columns.description: Stores the code for the field. Field Code can be defined like this ORA_*CONTEXT*_FIELD. For example - Candidate Name Field for Job Application Context , the field code can be ORA_JA_CAND_NAME

columns.name: FIELD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the information about what type of field is being defined. For eg :- ORA_GENERAL , ORA_COMPOUND , ORA_EFF_GENERAL , ORA_EFF_COMPOUND

columns.name: FLEX_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Stores the segment code of the flex field.

columns.name: FLEX_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Stores the context code of the flex field.

columns.name: PROFILE_CONTENT_SECTION_ID
columns.description: This column stores the Section Id for a given category.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
